zh-CN.title: 科研任务与会议邀请更顺手
items: 优化任务列表和详情，记录进展、提交周报时可以在 Markdown 编辑和预览间切换。
可直接新建会议，自选受邀成员，并在会议列表查看邀请。
从「资料与事务」直接添加资料、发放奖励或提交报销，待处理报销优先展示。

en.title: A smoother research workspace
items: Find tasks more easily and switch between writing and previewing Markdown for updates and reports.
Create meetings from the toolbar, choose who to invite, and find sent invitations in the meeting list.
Add materials, grant rewards, and submit claims from the workspace. Claims that need attention appear first.
